ops.title: decisions.db v0→v1 needs a migration path coordinated with cc-review
ops.description: capt-hook 12.14.0 bundles a cc_transcript whose decision_store wants PRAGMA user_version exactly 1, but ~/.cc-transcript/decisions.db is v0 with data (decisions + dispatch_heartbeats, 4.5MB) and open_decisions_sqlite only creates schema on an empty db — every DecisionWriter ledger write and heartbeat drops with a logged warning, flooding capt-hookd.log. The resident cc-review daemon (~/.cc-review/v1/bin) still opens and writes the v0 db, so the two products disagree about the shared ledger; archiving the db under a live cc-review split-brains it. Need either a v0→v1 migration in cc_transcript's open path or a coordinated cutover (cc-review release on v1 + one-time archive).

ops.text: A v0 decisions.db with data opens successfully (migrated or cleanly cut over) for both capt-hook workers and cc-review
No 'decisions schema version 0, want exactly 1' warnings in capt-hookd.log after the fix
